requirements.title: IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE true entails the listed IEEE arithmetic facilities
requirements.definition: IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE inquires support for IEEE arithmetic for a real kind; for a supported kind, normal numbers match an ISO/IEC/IEEE 60559 format, exact normal addition, subtraction, and multiplication conform for at least one rounding mode, ABS provides abs, IEEE_REM provides remainder, and IEEE_COPY_SIGN, IEEE_LOGB, and IEEE_UNORDERED provide copySign, logB, and compareQuietUnordered.

pending.support-datatype-inquiry-logical: Compile-time plan: call IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(0.0) and IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE() and assert scalar logical results; no support value is assumed.
pending.datatype-normal-add-subtract-multiply: Guarded branch plan: probe IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(0.0); supported branch evaluates 1.5+0.25, 1.5-0.25, and 1.5*0.5 and asserts exact 1.75, 1.25, and 0.75 normal results; unsupported branch records skip.
pending.datatype-abs-rem-copy-logb-unordered: Guarded branch plan: probe IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(0.0); supported branch asserts ABS(-1.5)==1.5, IEEE_REM(5.0,2.0)==1.0, IEEE_COPY_SIGN(2.0,-1.0) has magnitude 2.0 and IEEE_IS_NEGATIVE true, IEEE_LOGB(8.0)==3.0, and IEEE_UNORDERED(1.0,2.0) is false; unsupported branch records skip.

requirements.definition: For a kind with IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE true, IEEE_SUPPORT_DIVIDE inquires whether division conforms for normal operands and results; with the corresponding special-value support, division also conforms for NaN, infinity, and subnormal cases described by the source.

pending.divide-normal-conformance: Guarded branch plan: probe IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(0.0) and IEEE_SUPPORT_DIVIDE(0.0); supported branch asserts 1.5/0.5 == 3.0 and 1.0/4.0 == 0.25; unsupported branch records skip.
pending.divide-nan-conformance: Guarded branch plan: probe IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(0.0), IEEE_SUPPORT_DIVIDE(0.0), and IEEE_SUPPORT_NAN(0.0); supported branch asserts IEEE_VALUE(0.0,IEEE_QUIET_NAN)/1.0 is NaN through IEEE_IS_NAN; unsupported branch records skip.
pending.divide-inf-conformance: Guarded branch plan: probe IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(0.0), IEEE_SUPPORT_DIVIDE(0.0), and IEEE_SUPPORT_INF(0.0); supported branch asserts IEEE_VALUE(0.0,IEEE_POSITIVE_INF)/2.0 classifies IEEE_POSITIVE_INF, and 1.0/IEEE_VALUE(0.0,IEEE_POSITIVE_INF) is positive zero observed with equality to 0.0 and IEEE_IS_NEGATIVE false; unsupported branch records skip.

requirements.title: IEEE_SUPPORT_SQRT true entails SQRT conformance in supported classes
requirements.definition: IEEE_SUPPORT_SQRT inquires whether SQRT conforms to ISO/IEC 60559 for a real kind, including negative zero and accuracy requirements, with NaN, infinity, and subnormal cases covered under the corresponding support inquiries.

pending.sqrt-support-inquiry: Compile-time plan: call IEEE_SUPPORT_SQRT(0.0) and IEEE_SUPPORT_SQRT() and assert scalar logical results; no support value is assumed.
pending.sqrt-negative-zero: Guarded branch plan: probe IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(0.0) and IEEE_SUPPORT_SQRT(0.0); supported branch constructs nz=IEEE_COPY_SIGN(0.0,-1.0), pre-verifies IEEE_IS_NEGATIVE(nz), computes r=SQRT(nz), and asserts r==0.0 and IEEE_IS_NEGATIVE(r); unsupported branch records skip.
pending.sqrt-nan-conformance: Guarded branch plan: probe IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(0.0), IEEE_SUPPORT_SQRT(0.0), and IEEE_SUPPORT_NAN(0.0); supported branch asserts SQRT(IEEE_VALUE(0.0,IEEE_QUIET_NAN)) is NaN through IEEE_IS_NAN; unsupported branch records skip.
pending.sqrt-inf-conformance: Guarded branch plan: probe IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(0.0), IEEE_SUPPORT_SQRT(0.0), and IEEE_SUPPORT_INF(0.0); supported branch asserts SQRT(IEEE_VALUE(0.0,IEEE_POSITIVE_INF)) classifies IEEE_POSITIVE_INF; unsupported branch records skip.
pending.sqrt-subnormal-conformance: Guarded branch plan: probe IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(0.0), IEEE_SUPPORT_SQRT(0.0), IEEE_SUPPORT_SUBNORMAL(0.0), and RADIX(0.0)==2; supported branch computes m=MINEXPONENT(0.0)-1, e=(m-2)-MODULO(m-2,2), and additionally guards e >= MINEXPONENT(0.0)-DIGITS(0.0) so x=SCALE(1.0,e) is representable subnormal. It sets x=SCALE(1.0,e), prechecks IEEE_CLASS(x)==IEEE_POSITIVE_SUBNORMAL, and asserts SQRT(x)==SCALE(1.0,e/2) exactly; default real instance: m=-126, e=-128, x=2^-128, SQRT(x)=2^-64; double precision instance: m=-1022, e=-1024, x=2^-1024, SQRT(x)=2^-512. Unsupported branches record skip.
